li.title: Straff Venture's Ultimatum
li.text: A rider bearing the Venture banner arrives under flag of truce. The message is brief. Straff Venture commands the largest army outside the walls. He offers terms: surrender the city, hand over the atium cache, and he will permit the garrison to leave alive. There is no signature, only a seal. Straff has never permitted anything in his life. He takes.

li.title: Cett's Army Arrives
li.text: Dust rises from the western road. Ashweather Cett has brought his forces to Luthadel - not to ally with Straff, but to claim the prize for himself. Two armies now camp outside the walls, each watching the other as much as they watch the city. Breeze notes, with characteristic understatement, that at least the two of them might keep each other busy. Ham wonders aloud whether three-way sieges have any historical precedent. Nobody answers him.

li.title: Both Armies Move
li.text: The waiting ends the way everyone knew it would. Cett moved first, or Straff did - afterwards nobody agrees which, and it stops mattering within the hour.\n\nNeither of them can afford to let the other take the city intact, so neither of them waits any longer. Two assaults, opposite walls, the same night. Whatever they were watching each other for, they have stopped.

li.title: The Well of Ascension
li.text:
They broke through at the eastern gate before dawn. Elend went out to meet them because somebody had to be seen doing it, and he came back carried. The wound is through the gut. He will not last the night, and everyone who has looked at it knows so and has stopped saying it aloud.

Beneath the city, the Well is full. Raw Preservation, pooled and waiting, older than the Final Empire and patient as stone. Vin stands at its edge with the power of creation in reach and a dying man above her.

There is a bead of lerasium in the crew's keeping. There has only ever been the one.

li.title: He Swallowed It Without Ceremony
li.text:
The bead is small - barely larger than a pearl, pale and luminous in the mist-light. Vin puts it between his teeth and makes him swallow, and for a long moment nothing happens at all.

Then the metals ignite inside him like sixteen suns. Flesh closes over the wound from the inside out. The bookish king who could not swing a sword stands up carrying the power of a full Mistborn, and looks at his own hands as though they belong to someone he has not met.

The last gift of Preservation is spent. There will not be another.

li.cause: swallowed the last bead of lerasium

li.letterTitle: He Did Not Last the Night
li.letterText: He was lucid near the end, which was the cruelty of it. He wanted to talk about the treaty. Somebody held his hand and let him.\n\nThe bead stays in the crew's keeping, pale and warm and worth a kingdom. It bought nothing. That was the choice, and it was made with open eyes.

li.title: She Let It Go
li.text:
She held the power of creation for one breathless moment, and then she opened her hands.

The pool drains. Something shifts in the world's foundations - something ancient, patient, and terrible, which has been waiting a very long time for exactly this. Ruin is free. The ground trembles. Above, the mists thicken and do not thin again.

Whatever comes next, there is no undoing what has been done.
